Commentary.Commentary: That brings us to the close of the first ODI! New Zealand have come out with flying colours and would feel they have a chance to win the series now. Remember, it's a short series and it will be the hosts who shall be under the pump as they won't have much time to regroup. Will the Kiwis continue to march on or will the Men in Blue take this series down to the decider? Let's find that out in the second ODI in Pune on 25th October at 1330 local time (0800 GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Man of the Match, Tom Latham is really elated with the win and feels it has been a fruitful knock as keeping for 50 overs and then coming out to bat is never easy. Opines that the conditions were really humid, way different from home. Reckons he will bat wherever his team wants and whatever suits the team. On his reverse sweep, he says this is one shot he has been working on and it is always nice when it comes off. Informs they (he and Taylor) decided to rotate strike and ends by praising Ross Taylor for the way he played.

Kane Williamson says that it has been a brilliant performance. Credits his new ball bowlers. He also praises Virat Kohli's brilliant century. Mentions that it was a really good chase from them, one of the best in recent times. States that bowling was not easy in this heat and congratulates his bowlers for giving it their all. He is pleased about the 200-run stand between Taylor and Latham calling it special. Feels that the guys have a great attitude towards the game and is happy with the all-round performance.

Virat Kohli is a bit disappointed but feels it has been a satisfying knock from him. Admits that New Zealand took the game away from them in the second half of the chase. Adds when the opposition gets a 200-plus stand, they will often be at the right side of the result. Opines that the dew came in and they fell short. Feels that the wicket also settled down as the game progressed. Once again praises Latham and Taylor for tackling their spinners. On why didn't he make Jadhav bowl, he says they didn't feel like giving the ball to him as the wicket had turn and bounce and so he backed his frontline spinners. Gives a special mention to Pandya who bowled well.

The game was poised nicely till the 30th over with New Zealand needing 133 off 120 balls with 7 wickets in hand. But the Kiwis played with a calm head and didn't get carried away. One would feel the hosts were a wicket away to exploit the inexperienced middle order but that just didn't happen. Earlier in the day, their middle order woes sparked yet again. Virat Kohli was the lone warrior as he stayed till the end to power his side to 280 by stroking a ton in his 200th ODI which in the end proved below par as the Kiwis romped home with 6 balls to spare.

Latham and Taylor broke a few records, one being the highest 4th wicket stand for New Zealand and highest for any wicket at this venue. The former got to his ton but the latter departed just when his side was at the doorstep to victory. The Indians would ponder what went wrong today. Kumar and Bumrah didn't seem to be penetrative while the spinners had no answers against Latham-Taylor. The dew was also a factor which didn't help their cause either. Apart from Pandya and Chahal the rest just couldn't arrive to the party.

New Zealand have taken a 1-0 lead in the series and they have done that in some style. They have recorded the HIGHEST SUCCESSFUL ODI RUN CHASE AT THE WANKHEDE and that should tell you how well they have played here. Chasing 281, the visitors got off to a steady start but then lost three wickets when they had just 80 on the board. Ross Taylor, the experienced campaigner and Tom Latham, their go-to man got together to keep the hosts at bay. They kept rotating the strike, played the spinners to great effect and then pounced on the freebies that were on offer.

FOUR! It has taken just one ball for Nicholls to finish it off. This is simply brilliant from the Kiwis! They have chased down the target without breaking a sweat! They are delighted as they have done something which will shock the world at the moment. Well done! Length ball on middle, Nicholls hoicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 6 WICKETS!
Henry Nicholls walks in next, replacing Taylor. He has to come out when his side needs just a run to win.

OUT! Has that carried? Oh yes! It has! No one is celebrating, Bhuvneshwar Kumar almost started to walk near the run up area but Chahal slowly gets up and claims the catch. Now Taylor starts to walk back. Would you believe it? Ross Taylor survived an LBW scare but now departs when his side is almost over the finish line. Ball - Fuller in length on off, Taylor smacks it hard but finds Chahal at extra cover who takes a good low catch. Ross walks back to a big round of applause. New Zealand are just a run away from victory.
Yorker on the stumps, Taylor jams it out by coming down the track.
1 to win, Ross Taylor is on 95. Can he get a ton with a biggie and take his side over the line?
Length delivery outside off, Latham slaps it over cover for a single. Scores are level now!
Stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Short on off, punched towards point.
Fuller in length on off, drilled through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! The decision stands! Ross Taylor survives a scare and still has an opportunity to get a ton! Good length delivery, angling in, Taylor tries to hoick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Bumrah is really confident and Kohli takes the DRS! Replays roll in, front foot is just fine. Hawk Eye shows it's in line but would have clipped the stumps. That's it, the Kiwi dressing room is all smiles. In fact, they have crossed for a leg bye which means Taylor won't be on strike.
Howzzat???? Too late in the game but India have taken a review for an LBW appeal against Taylor. Bumrah looks very confident. Will Rosco survive to get a chance to earn his century?
Fuller on off, Taylor drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Short of a length delivery on middle, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Pitches it on off, bunted back down the track.
Leg bye! Spears it in on the pads, Taylor gets it off the pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Fuller in length, driven back to the bowler.
Nudges towards fine leg and takes the single.

Well played, Tom Latham! 5th ODI ton for this man! He came in when his side was in trouble, he was asked to bat in the middle order to strengthen it and boy, he has shown why he is banked so much. Raises his bat and sinks in all the applause that is on offer! Coming to the ball, length delivery on middle, clipped through square leg for one.
Good length on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Stands tall to this short ball and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Edgy! Back of a length delivery outside off, Taylor looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. It bounces in front of Dhoni, beats his dive and races away to the fence for a boundary. This is now the highest 4th wicket stand for NZ. Previous one was 191 between Ryder and Anderson against WI in 2014!
SIX! Oh Tom! You beauty! He picks the slower one and just whips this fuller ball over long on for a maximum. Simply outstanding! He moves to 99 now!
Wide! Fires it full and down the leg side, Tom walks across to flick but misses. The umpire calls it a wide, it was a harsh call.
Fuller ball on off, Ross looks to drive but gets an outside edge down to third man for one.

FOUR! And more runs! New Zealand are running away now! Another short ball on middle, Taylor swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Kuldeep Yadav in the deep, puts in a dive, he gets a hand to it but the ball still races away to the fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Banged! Back of a length delivery on middle, Taylor dances down the track and pulls it with authority over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on middle, from over the wicket. Tom chips it uppishly towards mid on for a single.
30 needed from 30 balls! Jasprit Bumrah is brought back into the attack.
Drops it short outside off, cracked through point for a single.
Flatter on off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery around middle, Latham misses his flick.
FOUR! Gets it off the meat again! Fuller ball outside off, Latham nails the reverse sweep through backward point. More importantly, he played it all along the ground. NZ are cruising through.
Drags his length short, Taylor camps back to cut but gets it off the inner half down to backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, driven through point for a single.
Gets down and sweeps it through square leg for one.

SIX! In the air... it's gone over the fielder! Flighted delivery around middle, Latham gets down and picks it up. He sweeps it and it goes aerially towards deep square leg. Manish Pandey in the deep is interested but the ball goes well over him to the fence for a maximum.
Just a shimmy down the track and it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Drops it short on middle, Tom goes back immediately and pulls it towards deep square leg. Karthik in the deep puts in a good diving effort to keep them down to one.
Floats it up outside off, swept towards square leg for a single.

There is a slight delay here. The Kiwi batsmen are having some drinks and understandably so. 49 to get from 42 balls and this is New Zealand's game to lose from hereon. Can the Indian bowlers pick up a wicket and open this game up again?
Edggggyyy! Drifting in from around off, Latham looks to drive it away but gets an outside edge past the vacant slip cordon. Runs two as Bhuvneshwar from short third man mops it up.
Tom tries to sweep but fails to make contact.
150-run stand comes up now! These two have batted so well and have almost taken their team home. Googly outside off, mistimed cut towards point for a quick single.
Around off, swept towards short fine leg off the inner half for a single.
Flatter in length and outside off, Latham gets back to cut but there is some extra bounce and as a result he gets beaten.
FOUR! What a hit that is! Kuldeep is a bit on the shorter side, Latham gets into the position and reverse swats it through backward point for a boundary to start the over. Superbly done!
Kuldeep Yadav is brought back into the attack now. 57 needed from 48 balls.
Fuller around middle, Latham gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it through point to keep strike.
Short and flat on off, Tom goes back and cuts it past a diving Yadav at backward point to come back for a double.
This time Ross tries to sweep but gets an inside edge on the boot and the ball rolls behind square on the leg side for a single.
Gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Beaten! For the first time tonight, Latham misses his sweep shot! Tossed up outside off, Tom misses the sweep and it's taken by Dhoni behind.
Tossed up on off, Taylor paddles down to fine leg for an easy single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is brought into the attack now. 63 needed from 54 balls.
This one goes off the pads and rolls towards square leg. Taylor is once again running at the danger end and is able to run back in. He is really, really tired now.

Fuller in length on off, Latham pushes it towards mid off and calls for the single. The Indians know that Taylor is really tired and hence throw it as his end, the striker's end. It misses and Taylor gets in.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, Tom looks to hit it through the line but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Short and a bit wide outside off, slapped through point for a single.
Leg bye! Good length delivery on middle, Latham misses his tuck as the ball goes off the pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle. Kohli first gives the ball to Kuldeep but then changes his mind and hands it over to Pandya...

Another shout for an LBW! Length delivery around leg, Latham misses his flick and once again is hit on the pads. The ball goes off the pads and the batsmen take a leg bye. Meanwhile, the Indians are appealing but the umpire turns it down as it was pitching outside leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Bang! That was off the meat! Taylor skips down to this length delivery and powers it down the ground for a boundary.
Rides the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Taylor taps this length delivery outside off towards point and sets off. Latham responds and Jadhav scores a direct hit at the striker's end but the southpaw is safely home.
These two are batting very sensibly. India need a wicket desperately.
Length delivery outside off, Taylor looks to cut but chops it towards point.
Short and on the body, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Cracked away! Latham now silences the crowd with this! Short and a bit wide outside off, Tom stands tall and flays it through backward point to pick up a boundary.
Good delivery! Slants it away on a back of a length outside off, Latham tries to push it away but the ball nearly kisses the outside edge of his bat. The crowd is right behind Bumrah now.

On a length and outside off, Ross Taylor tries to tap it away but gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball then rolls towards point and they look to take a single.Kedar Jadhav has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
A pacy bouncer on middle, Taylor is quick to duck under it.
Kohli and Dhoni are having a chat now as to what has to be done now. Meanwhile, Latham and Taylor enjoy some refreshments.
Good length delivery on middle and off, stabbed off the back foot.

Good length delivery on middle and leg, Tom Latham tries flicking it but the ball skids a bit off he surface and pings him on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show there was a slight inside edge there.
Short delivery on middle, Taylor rides the bounce and plays a tennis-forehand kind of shot for a single towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length in the channel on off, dabbed behind point for a single.

FOUR! Sloppy from Chahal! Fuller in length on off, Tom Latham just has a push towards mid off. Chahal moves to his right but lets the ball through him for a boundary. Not impressive at all. There are some serious worried faces in the Indian dressing room now.
Good length delivery outside off, tapped in front of point for a single.
Fuller delivery, nudged straight towards mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Fuller in length and on the pads, flicked past mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, tucked through the leg side for a single.
Stays in the crease and deftly hits it towards third man for one.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack. So Kohli wants both his frontline pacers to have a crack at the current pair now...

Loud shout for an LBW! Kumar bowls a length delivery on leg, Latham looks to flick it away but misses to be hit on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The Indian's don't challenge the review as it seemed to be pitching outside leg. Yes, Hawk Eye confirms!
Shortish outside off, ramped down to third man for one.

Direct hit and Taylor would have been gone! Back of a length outside off, tapped towards Kohli at covers. They try to take a single as Kohli has a shy at the striker's end. He misses but had he hit Taylor would have been sent packing as he gave up.

9th ODI fifty for Tom Latham! It's his 4th on the trot! He can play anywhere and will score runs no matter what. Well played, Tom. Good length delivery on the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side to add another couple to his tally.

Four Leg Byes! Length delivery drifting on the pads, Latham looks to clip it away but it brushes his pads and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. The runs keep coming for the Kiwis. 100-run stand is up between the two.
Kumar starts his second spell from over the wicket and hurls a length delivery on middle. Latham tries to pull but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Here comes Bhuvneshwar Kumar back into the attack. Can he provide a breakthrough that his side need?104 needed from 90 balls...
Short and turning away from off, Taylor dabs it past the man at short third man and gets a double.
Gives it more air, lands it full outside off. It turns further away as Taylor looks to drive it away, gets beaten.
Almost does him in the flight does Chahal! Tossed up wider outside off, Taylor goes after it. Gets it off the outside edge over cover-point for a couple.
Loopy delivery around off, RT presses forward in defense.
Comes down the track and drives it back to Chahal who fails to stop it in his followthrough. They take a single.
Flatter one on off, turning further away, Taylor reaches out to that one. Cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Beautiful from Latham! Pandya goes fuller on the stumps, Latham shimmies down a touch and just clips it with timing to beat the dive of Rohit Sharma at mid on to end the over with a boundary. Tom moves to 48 now!
Short of a length delivery, fired outside off, Latham looks to cut but gets beaten.
Length ball outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Good length ball outside off, driven on the up towards mid off for a quick single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched towards cover. Actually Tom chops it out.
Good length delivery on middle, worked with the angle towards Chahal at mid-wicket.

38th ODI fifty for Ross Taylor! It has been a valuable knock from the experienced player! But now he needs to carry on and convert this into a big one. Fuller on middle, Ross comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket to get a couple.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
Chahal sees Latham giving the charge and hence fires it down leg. Latham manages to get some bat as the ball goes off the inner half behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Taylor comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge past Kohli at first slip for a single.

Top edge... safe! Tossed it up nicely around middle and off, Latham gets down to sweep but gets a top edge. But much to the batsman's delight, the ball falls well short of the man at deep square leg. A single picked up.
Tossed up around middle, clipped with the spin towards square leg.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back into the attack!

Drinks time. Good going for New Zealand. The pair of Latham and Taylor has added 80 runs and is looking ominous for the opposition. They need 121 runs from 108 balls with 7 wickets in hand. Looks very gettable from here. India need to break this partnership as soon as possible to claw back into the contest.
On a length well outside off, Taylor reaches out to it and cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
Back of a length delivery angling away from Tom who cuts it to third man to rotate strike.
Good length ball outside off, glided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Fine leg was brought inside the circle and Taylor picked his spot to perfection! Slanting towards the pads, Taylor clips it through backward square leg to find the fence.
Fuller in length outside off, caressed to covers for a run.
Wide! Dug in short but down the leg side, Latham lets it go.
Full length ball outside off, Latham goes for a drive but mistimes it down the track.
Pandya is back on.
Taylor skips down the track but is not quite to the pitch of it and ends up blocking it.
Uses his feet and knocks it past the bowler for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
In line of the stumps, Taylor backs away and cuts it through point for a run.
Sweeps this one to deep square leg for a run.

Almost a wicket! Googly on middle, Taylor works it towards square leg and sets off for a run. Dhoni sprints after it, aims at the non-striker's end but misses. Had Dhoni hit, Ross was a goner. Kohli is not happy with Chahal. Actually, the throw was very powerful and that is why he didn't attempt to collect it.
Chahal is back into the attack!
Drops it short, Latham camps back to cut but the ball grips off the surface, turns and nearly kisses the outside edge of Tom's bat.
Loopy delivery around off, driven down to long off for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Nailed it! He is sweeping it really well! Tossed up delivery around middle, Latham gets down and sweeps it off the middle of the bat in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Comes ahead and milks a single down to long on for one more.
Drops it short outside off, Tom Latham camps back and pulls it towards long on for a single.
Shortish on off, dabbed square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Short and outside off, ramped down to third man for one.

Chance of a run out! Touch fuller around off, Taylor looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball rolls towards cover. He wants a single but seeing Jadhav attacking towards the ball, Latham sends him back. Kedar throws the ball at the striker's end but it hits Taylor on its way. He is down and looks to be in some pain. Murali Karthik on air says, with age you take time to turn around and that is what exactly happened to Ross here.

FOUR! Bang! Good length delivery on middle, Taylor skips down the track and goes bang over mid on. The ball just bounces before crossing the rope. This should get Taylor going as he has failed to time the ball tonight.
Slower one, angling in on middle, Taylor looks to clip but misses and is hit on the pads.
Wide! Short and angling down leg, Taylor tries to help it away but the ball is away from his reach.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tom slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, swept towards deep square leg for one.
Flatter on leg, Taylor camps back and tries to murder this but drags it off the inner half behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in on middle, worked off the back foot towards the leg side.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven towards covers.

50-run stand comes up between the two! Loopy full toss on middle, Latham gets down and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single. The job isn't done yet, these two need to take this game deep if New Zealand are to win.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller on off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Keeps it on a length and outside off, Taylor tries to dab it away but gets it off the outer half down to third man for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Taylor mistimes his cut towards point.
A bit fuller outside off, punched on the up through covers for a single.
Shorter and angling in, Taylor rolls his wrists towards backward square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Latham clips it towards mid on for a single.
Hardik Pandya is called back into the attack.
Flatter through the air around middle, Tom Latham plays it late towards short third man for a single.
Around middle, clipped off the pads towards fine leg for a single.
Comes dancing down the track and blocks.

FOUR! Edged and that's gone! Dhoni anticipates early and moves to his left but Taylor gets a thick outside edge and as a result the ball flies past the keeper's right for a boundary. Actually, Dhoni did the right thing but the edge changed the direction of the ball.
Tossed up on off, jammed out towards the left of the bowler who dives to stop it.
Flatter outside off, cut towards Dhawan at sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted delivery around off, Taylor lunges forward in defense. 164 needed from 150 balls.
Googly around middle, Taylor goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it down to long on for one.
Around middle, turning away a bit, Taylor has time to go back and work it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy full toss, dipping in, Tom Latham sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up outside off, defended towards the off side.
On the leg stump, paddled fine down the leg side by Taylor for a brace.
Quicker full ball on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Leans forward and drives it straight towards the cover region.
Gets down and across to sweep it towards backward square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery around middle and off, pushed into the cover region.
A bit short and outside off, slapped off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.

Beautifully bowled! Chahal gives it nice air, lands it full outside off, Taylor tries to drive but the ball turns away and nearly takes the outside edge of Taylor's bat. Dhoni collects and whips the bails off but Ross' back foot was grounded in time.
Flighted ball around middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Floated delivery outside off, driven in the gap through cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, it turns away a bit, Taylor looks to drive but gets an outside edge past first slip for a single.
Flighted delivery around middle, worked wide of mid on for a single.
Flatter outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Nicely done! Bowls the googly around middle and leg, Latham gets down and brooms it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Loopy leg break around off, it spins away after pitching, Tom Latham looks to push it away but gets beaten.
Loops it up outside off, Taylor goes back and turns it through square leg for one.
Floated delivery around middle and leg, whipped through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on!
Drops it short on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Slows it through the air on off, blocked off the front foot gently.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Shimmies down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one around middle, punched off the back foot.
Around middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Ross gets a bottom edge on this length delivery as it goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Picks the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, punched on the up through covers. Karthik from sweeper cover, comes running to his right, puts in a dive but the ball wins the race.
Gets behind the line and defends.
Fuller ball on off, Latham drives it square of the wicket towards point where Rahane dives full length to his right to stop a certain boundary.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Tom Latham defends it towards cover.
Comes down the track, almost yorks himself but still manages to jam it out.
Quicker through the air around middle, worked towards mid-wicket.

That was really scary! Flatter through the air on middle, Taylor makes room to cut but does so really late. Gets it off the outside edge down to third man as Dhawan mops it up. A couple taken. But it's not a safe stroke to play.
Once again paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
Loopy full toss on the pads, paddled fine down the leg side by Latham for a couple.
Tosses it up outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Gets forward and defends it solidly off the front foot. Just 3 runs and a big wicket from it.
Good length delivery, slanting away a bit, Tom Latham shoulders his arms. That wasn't far away from the off stump.
Fuller and angling in, Taylor looks to flick but gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through extra cover for a couple.

Tom Latham walks in next, replacing Guptill. Last year he had great success while opening the batting in India. Now he has been handed responsibility to take care of the middle order. Let's see if he can once again do the same.

OUT! Hardik Pandya strikes! What an excellent catch that is from Karthik! Pandya persists with the short ball, Guptill swivels to pull but the ball gets bigger on him. He gets a big top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Karthik in the deep comes running to his right, keeps his eyes on the ball and then dives forward to take a really good catch. He took one earlier as well but this one is just too good a catch. In fact, Harsha Bhogle on-air says he didn't pick it up at first but then when he did, he did it really well to cover good ground. Guptill departs after his scratchy knock.
Once again fails to play the ramp shot! He tried one in the previous over too. Shortish outside off, Martin tries to play the upper cut but gets beaten.
Quicker through the air around middle, Ross pushes it towards point. Guptill wants the single but is sent back.
Beaten! Bowls a googly, flatter through the air, Taylor makes room to cut but is beaten for pace. That wasn't far away from the stumps.
Drops it short outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover for a single.
Drifting in on middle, blocked solidly.

Good stop, Dhawan! Tossed up outside off, Guptill drives it off the front foot towards cover. Dhawan dives full length to his right, stops the ball and then immediately throws it back to the keeper in spite being off balance.
Tossed up delivery around middle, driven off the outer half towards cover for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is brought on to bowl.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Guptill arches back to play the ramp shot but fails to get going with the shot.
A bit short and angling in, tucked towards mid on for a single.
Once again Pandya bowls a short ball outside off, Taylor once again mistimes his cut to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Taylor mistimes his cut towards point.
Fuller in length on off, Martin tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge past the leg stump towards fine leg for a single.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Guptill stands tall and defends it with a straight bat.
Drinks are on the field!
FOUR! Pulled away! Yadav bowls a half-tracker on middle, Taylor camps back and pulls it through square leg. Dhawan in the deep puts in a dive but fails to stop it from crossing the rope.
Loopy delivery around middle, turning in, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the on side.
FOUR! Picks the wrong 'un! Shorter and wider outside off, Guptill camps back and cracks it through covers for a boundary.
Loopy delivery around middle, worked straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter through the air around off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Short stuff from Pandya, swiped through mid-wicket for a single.
Clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length on off, pushed straight back to the bowler.
Bowls it on a shorter length and this one comes back in, Guptill once again misses his tuck and wears it on the pads.
Hardik angles one in from around middle, Guptill misses his flick and is hit high on the pads.
Goes back and defends it from within the crease.
Ross Taylor leans ahead and drives it towards cover. Excellent over from Yadav, this!

A loud, loud shout for LBW! The umpire isn't too keen. Virat Kohli and Dhoni have a chat regarding the review but they take a lot of time before deciding against it. Loopy ball around middle, turning in as well. Taylor misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The umpire shakes his head to the appeal that has been made. Replays show it was in line but would have missed the stumps. So, good call from the hosts to not opt for the review.
Gets across and sweeps it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
The experienced, Ross Taylor walks in next, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Straight to Kedar Jadhav! This time he makes no mistake! Kuldeep Yadav gets the big fish! He bowls a googly, wider outside off and asking the Kiwi skipper to go after it. Kane makes room and tries to hit it over extra cover. Doesn't bother to keep it down and ends up spooning it to Jadhav stationed there. The crowd is back alive. Don't remember when was the last time Williamson departed for a cheap score.
On middle and leg, eased past a diving Kuldeep Yadav for a single towards long on.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Williamson clips it behind square on the leg side for a single to keep strike.
Leg bye! Angles in a length delivery on middle, Guptill misses his tuck and gets it off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Stays back and taps it towards point for a quick single.
Pandya digs in a short ball on middle, it gets big on Guptill who is in no position to play the pull shot. Gets a top edge which falls safely near mid-wicket. A single taken.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length on middle, defended from within the crease.
Hardik Pandya comes on to bowl!

NOT OUT! Inside edge saves Guptill! That is why he was keen on taking the referral! Yadav tosses it up around middle, it skids a bit as Guptill comes forward to defend. Misses and is hit on the pads. A huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Guptill is quick to take the DRS! Replays show there is a clear inside edge and the on-field decision has to be overturned!
A loud shout and up goes the finger. The umpire has adjudged Guptill LBW. The Kiwi opener takes the review instantly. Seems like he has got an inside edge there. Let's wait and find out...
Takes a stride forward and pushes it towards the cover region.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off. They pick up a single.
Loopy delivery around middle, Guptill looks to sweep but gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and a single is taken.
Tossed up around middle, defended off the front foot.
Floats it up outside off, driven down to long off for a single. Williamson is off the mark.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, Kohli moves to his spinner, Kuldeep Yadav who comes into the attack.

The batsman defends it from within the crease. Ha ha ha... that was nice and interesting. Guptill blocked this straight to Bumrah and the bowler mimed a shy at the stumps. What did Guptill do? He mimed an upper cut over the keeper! The crowd liked that. Nice to see. All in a friendly manner.

FOUR! Edged and through! Back of a length delivery outside off, Guptill tries to punch it on the up but there is some extra bounce and as a result he gets an outside edge which flies right between Dhawan and Dhoni to the third man fence. Why wasn't there two slips in place?
Spears in a yorker at the base of middle, Martin digs it out.
Kane Williamson, the skipper is the new man in, replacing Munro!

OUT! In the air... taken! Colin Munro falls to a slower one and fails to make the life count. Bumrah from over the wicket, nicely changes the pace and delivers it full on middle and leg. Munro tries clipping it away but the slowness on the ball brings his downfall. He gets a leading edge which balloons high in the air towards cover. Karthik moves backwards a bit, keeps his eyes on the ball and settles nicely under it. Never easy to take those under the lights. India get a breakthrough.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Colin Munro ducks under it.
Fires in a yorker on middle, Guptill manages to jam it out for a single.
FOUR! Carved away! Short and wide outside off, Munro sees the width and slashes at it. Gets it comfortably over cover-point to end the over with a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Goes around the wicker, bowls a length ball around off. It comes in with the angle and puts Munro in a tangle. He gets hit on the pads, then the ball deflects off the pads and rolls just above the off stump to Dhawan at first slip.
This is really good bowling! Sees Munro giving the charge, Bhuvi bangs in a short ball. Munro once again gets beaten. A good take by Dhoni as well.
Good bowling! Short of a length delivery on middle, Munro is beaten by the extra bounce as he fails to get going with his pull shot.
Angles in a short of a length delivery on middle, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Good length delivery on the pads, MG misses his flick as the ball rolls off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Gets back and tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
He is not an easy customer, says the commentator on air. Slants it away on off, gives no pace to it. Colin gets deceived by it.
Full toss outside off, Munro hits it straight towards the cover fielder.
Good running! Short of a length delivery on middle, Guptill hops and taps it towards mid on for a quick single.
Shortish and a bit wide outside off, Guptill smashes it straight towards Pandya at point. Guptill smiles and so does Hardik, as the Kiwi opener knows he has missed out on an opportunity to score.
On a length and outside off, Guptill taps it towards Karthik at cover-point and steals a single.
Fuller and veering in on the pads, wristed towards mid on.
Leans forward a touch and blocks it out gently.
This one comes back in from a length outside off, Martin tries to crunch it through the line but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
Short of a good length ball outside off, punched towards mid off.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.

In the air... safe! Once again bowls a slower one, Munro almost chips it towards Chahal at mid-wicket. The ball lands in front and then rolls behind. The Indian leggie gives it a chase by the time they take two.
Slower one around the pads, clipped uppishly towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time he gets it right! Back of a length ball on middle, Munro stands tall and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Stays back and stouts it out.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Kedar Jadhav has dropped a simple catch! Bumrah is not happy for the obvious reason! He bowls a length delivery on middle and leg, cramps the southpaw for room who already made room. He pulls it awkwardly towards deep square leg. Jadhav in the deep fails to judge it well as he comes in quite a few yards. He tries to take it over his head but the ball bursts through his fingers and then crosses the fence. Will Munro make the most of the life? We saw Kohli doing the same earlier.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Colin defends it from within the crease.
Hops back and works with the angle through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball, angling in, punched off the back foot towards cover.

Bhuvneshwar Kumar bangs in a short ball from around the wicket, Munro ducks to let it be. For some strange reason, the umpire calls it wide. That was really a harsh call. Virat Kohli has a word with the umpire and is certainly not happy with the call.
Once again bowls a knuckle ball, it's on the shorter side around off. Colin mistimes his punch towards cover.
Bhuvi goes short, it's on the leg stump line. Munro swivels and pulls it to deep backward square leg where Kuldeep Yadav mops it up. Two taken.
Spears in a fuller ball, it's a knuckle ball from Kumar. Colin tires to drive it away but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls near the stumps.
Serves a length delivery, nipping back in a shade, Munro dances down a bit and whips it straight to Chahal at mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery on off, Munro taps it in front of point for a brisk single.

What happened there? One of the floodlights is not working. Kohli is not happy and he has a discussion with the umpires. There is a halt in play. The batsmen have gone out of the field as well. Meanwhile, the lights are coming on slowly. It has lit up completely and here we go again after the delay...
On a length and comes back in a bit, Munro tries to heave it across the line but fails to do so as the ball sneaks under his bat and carries straight to Dhoni.
Back of a length and it straightens a touch off the surface, Guptill tries punching it through the line but once again gets it off the edge down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Edged but flies past Dhawan! On a length and pitched around off, there is some extra bounce as Guptill flashes at it. Ekes out an edge which flies to the right of Dhawan at first slip and races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Fuller ball but on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Very full around off, Munro jams it out towards cover.
Stands put and defends it down off the back foot.
Wide! Sprays it down leg, wide called by the umpire.
Short ball on middle and leg, Munro looks to pull but gets a top edge instead. The ball falls safely in the short fine leg region for a single.
Good stop, Kohli! A touch fuller on off, driven towards cover. Virat dives full length to his right, falls flush on the ground but manages to stop it with his right hand.
Good length ball on off, Munro punches it on the up towards mid off. Rohit Sharma the man there is off balance but still manages to hit the stumps at the bowler's end.

A loud shout for an LBW! Not given! Brilliant from Bhuvneshwar! Comes back in after landing and Munro has no clue about it. The ball sneaks under his bat, hits the pads and goes to Dhoni. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe, the height seem to be an issue there.
SIX! Excellent shot, that! Kumar hurls it on a length and tries to bring it back. What does Munro do? He walks across and just whips it over deep square leg for a maximum. He's nailed that shot!
Huge cheer from the crowd as Virat Kohli is back on the field...
Fuller and angling in on the pads, clipped straight to mid-wicket.
This one stays a touch low but Guptill crouches low to keep it out.

Edged but falls just short! Good length delivery, zipping away off the surface, Munro hangs his bat out but gets an outside edge which lands just short of Dhawan at first slip. The ball bursts through his hands and they take a single.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Colin Munro square drives it straight to Pandey at point.
This one comes back in from middle and strikes Munro high on the pads who tries to flick it away. An appeal for an LBW but it was going down leg.
Good delivery first up! Bumrah from over the wicket, drops it on a length and angles it away. Munro goes back to defend but there is extra bounce which beats Colin all ends up.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball. A slip and a wide second slip in place.
Keeps it in the channel outside off, Martin makes an easy leave.
Guptill pulls out at the last moment as there is some movement behind the sightscreen.
Fuller and swinging away after pitching, Guptill leans ahead and then shoulders his arms.
Lands it on a length around off, Guptill stands tall and blocks it firmly towards cover.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Not in perfect control of this one but still effective. Fullish ball on middle, Guptill drives it uppishly down the ground and past mid on to find the fence.
FOUR! The Kiwis are away! Fractionally overpitched on middle, Guptill leans ahead and drives it beautifully down the ground for a majestic boundary.
Starts off with a full length ball in the off stump channel, gets a hint of away swing. Guptill plants his front foot across and leaves it watchfully.

We are back for the chase. The men who matter stride out to the middle. Martin Guptill and Colin Munro to open the batting for New Zealand. The Men in Blue are in a huddle. Rohit Sharma is captaining India as Virat Kohli is not on the field. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to steam in with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
